animationRules.singleLane: Only the throwing arm aims: up for top, level for middle, down for bottom. Head, torso, and legs remain in idle pose.
animationRules.threeLanes: Use one flash beside Ninja only; never flash each lane.
animationRules.projectileOrigin: The throwing-hand socket; the weapon leaves the hand at release.

concepts.name: Ghim shuriken
concepts.motion: Straight throw, pin into the targeted lane.

concepts.name: Kunai hồi tuyến
concepts.motion: Curved throw and pin into the targeted lane.

concepts.name: Tán diệp
concepts.motion: Three shuriken fan out and pin one per lane.

concepts.name: Ảnh lá xuyên tuyến
concepts.motion: Horizontal hand seal, then a leaf-energy wave crosses all lanes; no thrown weapon.
